criteria.statement: The repository web image starts healthy on an isolated Docker network with neither bahia nor relay present.
tests: docker build -f web/Dockerfile ... web; isolated docker run health probe

criteria.statement: The static app shell returns HTTP 200 while the backend is absent.
An API request against an absent backend returns HTTP 502 without terminating or degrading the web container.
tests: isolated GET /api/health returns 502 while container health remains healthy
